name: named-pistol-marker-contract
description: The product's disposable-firearm-visual-rigs scenario in a fresh process at the main menu with no save and no other mods, for REP-03. The named pistols' marker contract is reported as separate relationships (authored marker set, required transforms, support-target policy, imported marker geometry, root markers at the authored markers in the prefab root frame, the declared held donor frame) and then as the aggregate pistol-authored-marker-contract. firearm-projectile-launch-source reports which unit transform the engine launches the firearm projectile from.
